requirements.quote: Adapter contract (command → normalised JSON) plus the memo, alertmanager, sql and prometheus adapters, read-only enforced except a declared close command.

`bin/lean/prodwatch-sources.mjs` exports the normalised signal shape `{id, source, title, severity, owner, first_seen, last_seen, body, query?}`, plus `parseSources(cfg)` for `prod_watch.sources` entries (`list`/`read`/`close`/`run`/`queries`), `runAdapter(source, io)`, and per-kind normalisers (memo dir, Alertmanager v2 alerts JSON, SQL rows, Prometheus vector with threshold).
Read-only enforcement: adapters execute only the declared `list`/`read`/`run` commands through `io.exec`.
`close` is reachable only through a separate `closeSignal()` that requires an audit record.
No other write path. Tests use injected exec fixtures.
Repo is PUBLIC: no raw customer data in fixtures.
Rules: pure functions with an injected `io` (exec/gh/llm/now) like bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs; read-only by contract; deterministic first; core stays repo-agnostic (#1347).

deliverables.change: New pure ESM module exporting normalizeSignal, parseSources, runAdapter, closeSignal and per-kind normalisers (memo, alertmanager, sql, prometheus). Only list/read/run are exec'd by runAdapter; closeSignal writes the audit record first and is the sole close path; placeholder values ({id},{issue},{reason}) validated/shell-quoted. No LLM, no fs/network except via io.

node:test with injected io.exec fixtures: each adapter's normalisation, Prometheus threshold crossing, parseSources validation errors, an exec-spy proving runAdapter never runs close, closeSignal refusing without audit/close command and auditing before exec, placeholder injection rejected. Synthetic data only.
Add one sentence beside the issuewatch paragraph describing prodwatch-sources.mjs (signal adapters, read-only, closeSignal audit) so check-devdocs-freshness passes.

preserve.what: bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs and bin/lean/issuewatch-release.mjs exports and behaviour (no edits; their tests stay green)
Enumerating tests under bin/lean and bin/engine (telemetry-seam, batch, checks, conformance, context, drift, execution, fixround) list unrelated sibling names; no change needed, none touched

decisions.choice: Do not reuse issuewatch.mjs parseWatches/scalar for sources; parseSources takes an already-parsed cfg object
decisions.justification: scalar (bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs:27-33) splits flow maps on commas and would break ssh commands containing commas; forge.yaml loading belongs to the runner (#4838)

decisions.choice: New standalone module with no dependencies; injected io.exec returning {code, stdout}
decisions.justification: Matches issuewatch injected-io pattern (bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs:1-12) and NORTHSTAR non-negotiable 1 (deterministic first)

decisions.choice: closeSignal appends the audit record before exec and refuses if the append fails
decisions.justification: Issue requires close to need an audit record; auditing first guarantees no unaudited write
